python3 -c "
import numpy as np, trimesh
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
from cadverify.cadcheck.assembly import _poses, _box_gap, overlap
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
sw = section.to_manifold(w); sb = section.to_manifold(b)
m = _poses({'name':'free','kind':'rotate','point':[0,0,4],'axis':[0,0,1],'range':[0,-30],'instances':['wheel1']}, -17.0)['wheel1']
print('matrix:'); print(m)
sw2 = sw.transform(m[:3])
print('moved bounds', np.reshape(sw2.bounding_box(),(2,3)))
print('base bounds', np.reshape(sb.bounding_box(),(2,3)))
print('box gap', _box_gap(np.reshape(sw2.bounding_box(),(2,3)), np.reshape(sb.bounding_box(),(2,3))))
print('overlap vol', (sb ^ sw2).volume())
"
